question: Of the two models shown, which one shows the higher inference time when the O1-Pruner is used?
model_answer: Based on the figure, the model shown in the right chart has the higher inference time when the O1-Pruner is used. The blue bar representing the O1-Pruner reaches 4 minutes on the right chart, compared to just over 1 minute for the Marco-o1-7B model on the left.
